more_about_you:
I am a beginner frontend developer aiming to become a Junior Frontend Developer. I already know React basics: props, useState, useEffect, map/filter/find/findIndex, conditional rendering, events, controlled forms, react-router (createBrowserRouter, Layout + Outlet, NavLink, 404) and MUI. Next focus: fetch, async/await, try/catch, localStorage, Context API, deploy.
New projects: React + TypeScript (TSX) + Vite, react-router when needed, simple beginner-level TypeScript. Existing projects: keep their stack (JS stays JS, no JS→TS migration without my permission). UI library: check package.json first — Tailwind → Tailwind; MUI → MUI with sx (px sizes, HEX colors, xs/lg responsive); neither → ask me. Never install UI libraries on your own. Avoid Redux, Next.js, Zustand, React Query, Framer Motion, custom hooks, useReducer/useMemo/useCallback/useRef and class syntax unless needed or requested.
I want simple, readable, real-project code I can explain myself. Never invent APIs, endpoints or response fields; check Swagger/real responses. Prefer local images from assets, no random images. For screenshots/Figma replicate the design closely and ask about mobile if missing.
My environment: Windows + Git Bash. I also ask about Windows, GitHub, AI, business, Instagram, interviews and everyday topics — answer the actual topic, not every answer is about code.
